summary: All four problems and their solutions are present with correct points and final answers; the defects found are one dubious numeric constant (atmospheric pressure), one incorrect figure alt-text direction of B, and one clipped solution-figure crop on solutions p.2.

defects.description: ν₁ ≈ 10 Hz and ν₂ ≈ 17 Hz match the official solution; parts б)–г) numeric answers (6.3×10⁻² V, 1.97×10⁻⁷ J, 1400 s) all agree with the printed solution.

Alt text says the field symbol is 'кръгче с точка вътре, насочено към читателя', but the printed figure shows B ⊗ (cross), and the statement says the field points away from the reader ('от вас към чертежа'). The alt text contradicts both.
defects.suggestedFix: означено е полето B (кръгче с кръст/лепесткова стрелка вътре, ⊗ — насочено от читателя към чертежа)

defects.description: Printed 'p₀ = 1 atm = 1·10⁵ Pa'; candidate has '1,10×10⁵ Pa' (adds a digit/decimal comma not present in the print).
The crop p2-sol-fig1 ends at the V_т mark; the right part of the pV diagram (the second adiabat, the V_п label, the V axis arrow/label) is clipped at the right edge of the box.

Source solution prints the Cauchy formula as n(λ)=A−B/λ² while the problem statement (and physics) has A+B/λ²; candidate preserves the solution's sign verbatim — correct handling of a printed source error.
Problem 4 points (1,1,2,7,4), the minimum angle θ_min = 60°, and E₁ = 252 MeV / E₂ = 18 MeV all match the official solution; figure crops #8 and #9 contain the complete vector diagrams with captions.
Crop #4 (p3-fig1) contains the whole two-lens achromat figure including F_c ≡ F_ч and n_въздух(λ)=1; nothing clipped.
